title: haven: replay Haven's protocol07-vectors.json in mimid as a permanent test
description:
Haven ships 34 protocol-07 wire vectors: tests/vectors/protocol07-vectors.json (generator examples/gen_protocol07_vectors.rs, last changed 07ce96f, unchanged at edd3ba1). These are separate from our own Haven fixtures in crates/mimi-protocol/tests/fixtures/haven.

Exploratory replay through mimid decoders on 2026-11-14 (temporary test, removed):
- KeyMaterialResponse: km-01..08 decode and re-encode byte-identical. km-09 (exhausted) refused: DIV-13, mimid-1wgh.46.1.7. km-x2 and km-x3 refused by both. km-x1 (foreign suite on the second client): Haven refuses, mimid's codec decodes it, because mimid checks the suite later, not at decode. Confirm that the later check exists.
- UpdateRoomResponse ur-01..04 and KeyPackage kp-x1 (GREASE): decode and re-encode identical.
- UpdateRequest up-x2 (proposal bundle): identical.
- Every Commit bundle (hb-01..03, up-01..05, up-x3..x7) is refused by mimid. The Commit MLSMessage and the Welcome parse; what fails is the fields after them:
  (a) RatchetTreeOption: Haven writes opaque bytes (placeholder ccdd in hb-01, empty in hb-02 and up-*), not a RatchetTreeOption (Haven DIVERGENCES DIV-11).
  (b) Partial GroupInfoOption: Haven writes 02 + a length prefix + an opaque payload (hb-03: 40 bytes of 0xab; up-*: an empty payload), not a raw PartialGroupInfo (Haven DIV-12).
  So these vectors can't exercise mimid's participant-list and room-policy rules (up-03..05, up-x4..x7) until they are rebuilt with real fields.

To do: commit the vectors with a PROVENANCE file and add a replay test that asserts the outcomes above with bead references. Ask Haven whether a regenerated set with valid RatchetTreeOption and PartialGroupInfo is possible, or rebuild the semantic cases on our side. Report upstream only with Mark's per-action OK.
